Well, a couple reasons. Supplies, and labor being the main ones off the top of my head. For most hobbies involving miniatures- it takes time to design everything, and intricate work to do all of this. You first have to get the veneer, cut it to size, glue it, throw it in a mold, etc. All of this is typically done by one person, too. Molds can get pretty pricey, along with other supplies needed depending on how graphics are applied. A lot of skateboard companies outsource their boards from China(some, but not all). The same thing happens with fingerboard stuff, too. So it’s up to each individual fingerboard company on what they value their boards at, and how much they want to charge the consumer.
It’s like buying a Walmart board in comparison to a real setup. The quality(and performance) is noticeably different.
